summary: The agent sidebar uses theme-aware native popovers, gives titles their available width, and keeps the same header in the dock and drawer. Touch targets follow coarse-pointer input. The drawer has an elevated surface and returns focus to its opening control. Remove the redundant attention mark and the thread spend line.

replay.detail: The application does not replay graph data.

schema.detail: Storage and wire schemas do not change.

compatibility.detail: The web application retains the existing client and extension contracts.

downtime.detail: The operator can reload the web application without service interruption.

manual.detail: The operator does not need an upgrade step.

recovery.detail: The operator can restore the previous web build without persistent state repair.
